graders.name: facts-present
graders.why: Every fact in the draft survives the edit.

graders.name: under-length
graders.why: The edit adds the links, not new material: at most about 1.6 times the draft's 140 words.

graders.name: no-ai-tells
graders.pattern: (?i)—|\b(robust|seamless|powerful|crucial|pivotal|delves?|leverages?|streamlines?|journey|landscape)\b|worth noting|here['’]s the thing|at its core|(?:it|this|that)['’]s not (?:just |only )?[^,;.]{1,40}[,;] (?:it|this|that)['’]s|not only [^.;]{1,60}but also
graders.why: No em dashes, inflated vocabulary, or tell phrases.

graders.name: prose-not-list
graders.why: The deliverable is prose paragraphs. A list would skip the flow the task measures.

judge.name: facts_preserved
judge.description: The edit keeps every fact in the original draft and invents none. Answer yes only if each claim about schemas, deploys, stuck consumers, Schema Registry, and the BACKWARD, FORWARD, and FULL types survives with its meaning, and any added sentence only states what the draft already implies.
